question: Should imsg core support this stats API as `imsg stats` plus `server.getMessageStats`, `getMediaStatistics`, and `getMediaStatisticsByChat` with the proposed payload shape?
rationale: The patch appears technically focused, but new CLI commands and JSON-RPC methods become a compatibility contract after release and need maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Accept stats API
options.body: Merge after confirming the current command name, RPC method names, and JSON fields are the intended supported contract.

options.title: Narrow or rename
options.body: Ask for fewer RPC methods, different names, or adjusted payload fields before the feature ships.

options.title: Defer built-in stats
options.body: Pause or close the PR if maintainers want aggregate message statistics to remain outside core imsg for now.

recommendation.title: Accept stats API
recommendation.body: Merge after confirming the current command name, RPC method names, and JSON fields are the intended supported contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-main history for the RPC and MessageStore contract surface that this PR extends.
